# Protocol API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

A written method the lab reuses, such as a standard operating procedure.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/protocol/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/personal_attributes/protocol/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `protocol` (detail, create, update), `protocols` (list)
- **Permissions:** object permissions on the record itself (member / manager / owner roles)
- **Deleting:** also deletes the linked [`protocolgroupmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/protocolgroupmembershipinvitation/), [`protocolmembershipinvitation`](/api/personal_attributes/protocolmembershipinvitation/) records; refused (400) while [`procedure`](/api/modules/procedure/), [`procedureepisode`](/api/modules/procedureepisode/), [`procedureepisodetemplate`](/api/modules/procedureepisodetemplate/), [`proceduretemplate`](/api/modules/proceduretemplate/), [`subjectlog`](/api/modules/subjectlog/) records point to it; clears the link on [`specimenlog`](/api/modules/specimenlog/), [`specimenprocedure`](/api/modules/specimenprocedure/), [`specimenproceduretemplate`](/api/modules/specimenproceduretemplate/) records

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 255 characters |
| `description` | string; nullable |
| `url` | string; max 200 characters |
| `protocol_type` | one of `breeding`, `procedure`, `specimen_procedure`, `subject_log`, `specimen_log` **[required]** |
| `subtypes` | list of strings |
| `subtype_display` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `licenses` | list of [`license`](/api/personal_attributes/license/) ids; nestable. Licenses that authorize this protocol |
| `attachment` | string; max 100 characters |
| `is_public` | boolean. Designates if the protocol is publicly available |
| `procedures` | list of [`procedure`](/api/modules/procedure/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `subjectlogs` | list of [`subjectlog`](/api/modules/subjectlog/) ids **[read-only]**; nullable; nestable |
| `users` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `groups` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/protocol/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('protocol', load_all=True)
records = resp['protocols']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('protocol', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.protocols;
```

```json
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/protocol/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('protocol', data={"name": "Protocol 1", "protocol_type": "breeding"})
record = resp.json()['protocol']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Protocol 1', 'protocol_type', 'breeding'), 'protocol');
record = created.protocol;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/protocol/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('protocol', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['protocol']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('protocol', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.protocol;
```

### Response example

```json
{

            "<procedure-id>"
        ],
        "subjectlogs": [
            "<subjectlog-id>"
        ],
        "users": null,
        "groups": null,
        "user": "<user-id>"
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/protocol/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('protocol', id='<id>', data={"name": "Protocol 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Protocol 1 (renamed)'), 'protocol', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/personal_attributes/protocol/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('protocol', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'protocol');
```

## Usage notes

- `attachment` is a file, not text: upload it as multipart form data (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, CSV, Markdown or plain text, up to 15 MB). Responses return a signed download URL.
- `subtypes` are type codes of the selected `protocol_type`: [procedure types](/api/schemas/procedure/) for `procedure`, [specimen procedure types](/api/schemas/specimenprocedure/) for `specimen_procedure`, [subject log types](/api/schemas/subjectlog/) for `subject_log` and [specimen log types](/api/schemas/specimenlog/) for `specimen_log`. Codes are case-sensitive. An empty list makes the protocol apply to every type; when you change `protocol_type`, send matching `subtypes` (or `[]`) in the same request.
